evidence.quote: The business reporters should go get coffee or something, because I am not going to say anything about the markets or monetary policy.
We are in a recession, and the labor market is weak.
The economy will recover--it has too many fundamental strengths to be kept down for too long--and the mood will brighten.
Restoring economic prosperity and maximizing economic opportunity are the central focus of our efforts at the Fed.
